label: Rubber-band selection
behaviour: Dragging from an empty spot draws a selection rectangle; every icon it touches is selected.

label: Drag to move
behaviour: Dragging an icon moves it to the drop point; onto a folder icon, the item moves into that folder.

label: Ctrl-drag copy
behaviour: Holding Ctrl while dropping copies the item instead of moving it.

label: Alt-drag shortcut
behaviour: Holding Alt while dropping creates a shortcut to the item.

label: Ctrl and wheel icon size
behaviour: Ctrl with the mouse wheel steps the icon size through small, medium and large.

label: Double-click to open
behaviour: Double-clicking an icon opens it, as Enter does.

label: Move to
behaviour: Drag tip beside the pointer, followed by the target folder's name, when the drop will move the item.

label: Copy to
behaviour: Drag tip with the copy cursor (a plus badge) when Ctrl is held or the target is on another drive.

label: Create link in
behaviour: Drag tip with the link cursor (an arrow badge) when Alt is held.

label: Rename
behaviour: Turns the selected icon's label into an edit box; Enter keeps the new name, Esc keeps the old.
